languages.coverage: All entries in the downloaded ISO 639-3 registry snapshot; includes living, historical, extinct and constructed languages. Language selection does not translate the interface.

countries.coverage: 249 ISO 3166-1 country and territory entries in the source snapshot. Territories are included; this is not a list of 249 sovereign states.

stars.coverage: Named entries from WGSN NEC and faint-star CSV snapshots, plus the Sun. Unnamed NEC entries are excluded; later naming decisions may not appear. Not all stars in the universe.

planets.coverage: The eight Solar System planets plus all confirmed exoplanet rows in the downloaded NASA PSCompPars snapshot. Dwarf planets are not included in this category.

systems.coverage: Our Solar System plus distinct host systems represented in the downloaded NASA confirmed-exoplanet snapshot. Only our system is called the Solar System; no complete census of all systems is implied.

satellites.coverage: 461 natural satellites: all 460 rows in the JPL planetary/Pluto table, plus Earth’s Moon. Also eight selected ISRO Earth-satellite missions; artificial coverage is illustrative, not a global spacecraft registry. No small-body moon census or live tracking.

galaxies.coverage: Galaxy-classified entries (S/E/E?/IR) in the HEASARC Messier table, plus the Milky Way. The source table was last modified in 2022. A bounded reference collection, not all galaxies.
